source: Descriptions: the game's own passive text, shortened. Armors: helldivers.wiki.gg (the Armor page and each armor passive's page), read 2026-09-30.
note: Plain description and the body armors that carry each armor passive. Community data: corrections welcome. After editing, run: python tools/picker.py export-web

Acclimated.desc: 50% fire, gas, acid and arc resist.

Adreno-Defibrillator.desc: One short revive after a death (body intact); stims last 2 s longer; 50% arc resist.

Ballistic Padding.desc: 25% chest and 25% explosive resist; no chest bleeding.

Blunt-Force Mitigation.desc: Harder to knock down; 30% impact resist; higher armor rating.

Concussive Padding, Hazmat.desc: 50% explosive resist; 25% gas resist; 30% less sidearm recoil.

Democracy Protects.desc: 50% chance to survive a lethal hit; no chest bleeding.

Desert Stormer.desc: 40% fire, gas, acid and arc resist; +20% throw range.

Engineering Kit.desc: 30% less recoil crouched or prone; +2 grenades.

Feet First.desc: 50% quieter movement; +30% point-of-interest range; no leg injuries.

Fortified.desc: 30% less recoil crouched or prone; 50% explosive resist.

Gunslinger.desc: Sidearms: +40% reload speed, +50% draw speed, 70% less recoil.

Integrated Explosives.desc: Armor explodes 1.5 s after you die; +2 grenades.

Kinetic Displacement Mitigation.desc: 50% fire resist; 50% chance to avoid limb injury; 30% impact resist.

Oxygenator.desc: Faster walking and running; faster, longer slides.

Reduced Signature.desc: 50% quieter movement; enemies spot you from 40% closer.

Reinforced Epaulettes.desc: +30% primary reload; 50% chance to avoid limb injury; +20% melee damage.

Rock-Solid.desc: +40% melee damage; harder to knock down.

Scout.desc: Map markers scan for enemies every 2 s; enemies spot you from 30% closer.

Siege-Ready.desc: +30% primary reload; +20% ammo for all weapons (not backpacks).

Supplemental Adrenaline.desc: Taking damage restores stamina; higher armor rating.

True Grit.desc: +30% support weapon reload; better weapon handling.

Unflinching.desc: Less flinch when hit; higher armor rating; map markers scan every 2 s.
